propositions: Six src/rebar files exceed 786 LOC and approach or reach the 800-LOC hard cap, creating CI failure risk when any change (including comments) is made to them
The 800-LOC module-size limit in .github/module-size-limit.txt is locked and cannot be raised; any edit pushing a file over 800 LOC fails the gate with no allowlist

Files must be split along existing logical concerns and architectural call-graph boundaries, not mechanically carved to reach a number, and resulting files must be 100-500 LOC with real headroom below 720 LOC
Behavior-preservation is mandatory: existing tests must pass unmodified after splits; any test modification indicates the split was not behavior-preserving and must be reconsidered
Registry, allowlist, and line-budget entries keyed to moved symbols must be updated in the same change as the move to prevent stale configuration from breaking CI on the next run
